localChanges: You can now find any city you know of: press / or choose Find City in the Game menu, type part of its name, with or without its accents, and the map moves to it (closes #346).
A new game now always opens with the map centred on your start position (closes #705).
On a phone, the page now fits the screen: the address bar no longer covers the top of windows, windows fit the screen's width, and a tap on the map lands where you tapped (#765).
Playing on a phone is still a work in progress: some screens don't fit yet, the city screen most of all (#812).
